description: A single household activity-feed event: type-keyed icon chip, description, actor + relative-time subtitle, and an optional signed amount. Visual sibling of the dashboard's RecentActivity row.

eventType.description: ActivityEvent.event_type; drives icon + tint + amount sign via tintForEvent().

actorGlyph.description: { glyph: '◑'|'◐', color: string, name: string } | null. Null in solo households or unknown actor.

relativeTime.description: Pre-formatted relative time, e.g. '2h ago', 'Yesterday at 9:02 AM'.

amount.description: Event amount; omit for events with no monetary value (budget_created, goal_created).

onPress.description: Navigate to the underlying entity. Provided only when entity_id + entity_type exist; otherwise the row is a non-pressable View.

typography.name: typography.smallBold + colors.text (numberOfLines 1)
typography.subtitle: typography.caption + colors.textMuted (numberOfLines 1); actor glyph rendered in actorGlyph.color

accessibility.label: {description}, by {actorGlyph.name}, {relativeTime}{, income|expense {amount} when present}.
accessibility.colorIndependence: direction encoded by icon shape + +/- prefix + color; actor by glyph + name
